dimension_explanations.alignment: The charity has a high fit for Muslim donors as it is Zakat-eligible and serves urgent global health needs [4][14]. Its financial health is stable with Working Capital of 3.4 months [12].

rich_narrative.summary: MedGlobal operates as a medical relief organization providing direct healthcare services to vulnerable populations in international crisis zones. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="2">total revenue of $12,632,992</cite>, reflecting its capacity to mobilize significant resources for global health. The charity maintains a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 85.9%</cite>, which indicates that its reported spending is entirely dedicated to service delivery. However, donors should note that the <cite id="1">cash-adjusted program ratio is 71%</cite> when accounting for the high volume of non-cash contributions. MedGlobal is <cite id="3">verified as zakat-eligible</cite>, specifically serving categories such as the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin). While the organization demonstrates <cite id="1">efficient fundraising at $0.05 per $1 raised</cite>, its overall assessment is balanced by gaps in formal governance documentation and the lack of a published theory of change. The charity's work spans high-urgency regions including <cite id="3">Syria, Yemen, and Pakistan</cite>, where it provides essential health services at refugee camps and health posts.
